confirmed_findings.title: Top-level inventory can be false-green
confirmed_findings.root_cause: system_intelligence.py:415-425 computes status only from observations and excludes services, readiness, manager ownership and diagnostics.
confirmed_findings.impact: Dashboard can show inventory VERIFIED while service identities are STALE/UNKNOWN or readiness is unavailable/unknown.

confirmed_findings.title: Manager handoff contract drift blocks collector tests
confirmed_findings.root_cause: The test imports _manager_handoff_status and expects managerHandoff, while the implementation defines neither; UI and operations guide also expect a handoff result.
confirmed_findings.impact: Focused collector tests fail at collection and the UI cannot display structured manager handoff evidence.

confirmed_findings.title: System inventory lacks connected-session age expiry
confirmed_findings.root_cause: Provider marks stale for pending request/error/disconnect, and UI displays generatedAt but does not derive freshness while a live connection remains open.
confirmed_findings.impact: An old successful snapshot may remain AVAILABLE until explicit refresh or disconnect.

confirmed_findings.title: Transport/heartbeat are not full health checks
confirmed_findings.root_cause: LIVE is set after subscription acknowledgment; heartbeat reports runtime state and gateway uptime, not all service readiness.
confirmed_findings.impact: Must not use connected state or heartbeat alone to claim application health.

confirmed_findings.title: Current live runtime/authenticated browser path
confirmed_findings.root_cause: No prior PIDs or port listeners were observed at the recheck time; no replacement runtime identity or authenticated browser result was established.
confirmed_findings.impact: Live dashboard state and current source provenance are unknown.

prioritized_fix.objective: Complete a truthful, testable System Intelligence inventory aggregate contract.
scope: Compute top-level status from service process identity/readiness and manager-ownership evidence as well as host observations.
Restore the documented managerHandoff result, or deliberately update UI, tests, and documentation together to one explicit contract.
Preserve UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE distinctions and never treat listener presence as readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Host observations succeeding while any required service is stale/missing cannot yield overall VERIFIED.
Ambiguous/missing manager ownership produces an explicit non-eligible state and reason.
Collector tests import and execute; tests assert the overall status and manager handoff behavior.
Authenticated gateway and frontend stale/error-state tests continue to pass.
A connected but aged snapshot has a defined, tested freshness policy distinct from browser receipt time.
proposed_regression_tests: Create temporary state with valid host facts but stale/missing service identity and assert top-level status is not VERIFIED.
Create manager fixtures for no owner, multiple owners, and parent mismatch; assert blocked/uncertain result and no state rewrite.
Assert inventory includes the documented managerHandoff contract.
Test browser rendering of a stale/expired inventory and timestamp semantics.
safety_prerequisites: No live service restart or runtime mutation.
Use only temporary test state and fake WebSockets.
Keep authentication and fixed manager-owned operation boundary unchanged.
For any future live verification, first satisfy runtime ownership, release, rollback, backup, restoration, and explicit operator authorization gates.

what_genuinely_works: A source-level authenticated inventory request and fixed helper-action path exist.
Host/process/listener observations are taken from OS sources and include source/status/time metadata.
The focused authenticated gateway tests passed (2) and the selected frontend tests passed (20).
final_disposition.system_intelligence_gap: Top-level status omits service identity/readiness and manager ownership; managerHandoff is expected by UI/tests/docs but absent from collector, causing focused runtime test collection failure.
final_disposition.highest_value_fix: Complete the truthful System Intelligence aggregate and handoff contract, with false-green and stale/ambiguous ownership tests.
final_disposition.safe_implementation_requirements: Repair test/source contract drift, use temporary fixtures, review exact diff, run focused Python/frontend tests, and do not restart services or bypass ownership/auth gates.
